capabilities: Capture ideas as linked Markdown cards
Browse cards in a masonry feed
Search and filter cards by text, tags, and colors
Merge cards into an article or place them on canvas
extras: Mobile-first but also works on desktop; minAppVersion 1.5.0, verified on Obsidian 1.5.12 / Android WebView Chrome 83. Uses only official Obsidian APIs; explicitly requires no Dataview or third-party plugin. README includes a Chinese summary; npm test covers link, box, canvas, graph, rename, and diagnostic suites.
problem: Obsidian lacks a mobile-first slipbox workflow for capturing ideas as linked cards, filtering them into condition-based boxes, and assembling them into articles.

relations.evidence: Slipbox is a mobile-first Obsidian plugin inspired by Writeathon.

summary: Writeathon-style slipbox that captures ideas as linked Markdown cards, organizes them in a masonry feed, and merges them into articles.
